items.briefing:
Two threats worth knowing about right now: phishing attacks using fake device login codes have surged 1,500% this year, and voice-based scams (where attackers call pretending to be IT support or trusted contacts) have doubled. These tactics are designed to trick everyday users into handing over access credentials without realising it. Separately, attackers are actively exploiting a security flaw in N-able, a remote management tool used by many IT teams — if your organisation uses it, check with your IT provider that it's fully patched.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected call or message asking you to approve a login code or provide your password, stop and verify the request through a separate, trusted channel before doing anything.
